summary: Flexbox inside of summary in the details box is a neat way to quickly layout accordion content. Just added a media query to change flex direction on mobile devices. Thanks to those who pointed out the issue: https://buildyourfirstwebsitelessonplans.glitch.me/ #digped
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: Flexbox inside of summary in the details box is a neat way to quickly layout accordion content. Just added a media query to change flex direction on mobile devices. Thanks to those who pointed out the issue: https://buildyourfirstwebsitelessonplans.glitch.me/ #digped
